Scenario: A school wants AI to grade student essays automatically.
Decision Options: Allow / Allow with Safeguards / Do Not Allow
Facilitator Notes: A balanced answer usually requires teacher review, transparent criteria, and an appeal process.

Scenario: A school wants facial recognition cameras at the entrance.
Decision Options: Allow / Allow with Safeguards / Do Not Allow
Facilitator Notes: Discuss whether the benefit is strong enough to justify sensitive biometric data.

Scenario: Students want to use AI to draft assignments.
Decision Options: Allow / Allow with Safeguards / Do Not Allow
Facilitator Notes: Discuss acceptable support, required citation or disclosure, and tasks where independent work is needed.

Scenario: A teacher wants AI to summarize anonymized class feedback.
Decision Options: Allow / Allow with Safeguards / Do Not Allow
Facilitator Notes: This can be reasonable if student identities and sensitive details are removed.

Scenario: An AI tool recommends which students need extra support.
Decision Options: Allow / Allow with Safeguards / Do Not Allow
Facilitator Notes: AI should support attention, not make final decisions without teacher review.

Scenario: A chatbot gives mental health advice to students.
Decision Options: Allow / Allow with Safeguards / Do Not Allow
Facilitator Notes: This is high risk. Students should be directed to qualified human support.
